title: Nexus Playground
tagline: A drag-and-drop visual composer to play around with Avail Nexus
description:
Nexus Playground is a visual builder for cross-chain workflows. It lets you design, preview, and run complex actions like transfers, bridges, swaps, contract calls, and staking across EVM networks using the Avail Nexus SDK. You get a simple drag and drop canvas to connect steps, set parameters, and see what will happen before you execute.

- Build visually: Compose workflows with a clean, modern UI and clear node-based steps.
Preview with confidence: See route details, estimated outputs, gas, and fees with live simulations.
- Do more with less setup: The app connects your wallet, reads balances across chains, and auto picks routes when possible.
- Flexible controls: Choose source chains, set slippage, and pass parameters to contract calls.
Works for mainnet and testnets: Toggle networks and explore without manual environment switching.

It is a fast way to prototype cross-chain experiences and share them with your team. Developers can validate ideas quickly. Product folks can see exactly how a user journey will execute from start to finish.
how_its_made: This project uses Avail Nexus SDK at its core and Wallet Connect SDK for the wallet management. The framework is made using Typescript + NextJS, and we are using Shadcn and Tailwind for UI/UX. Currently, it's desktop-based, but the larger goal is to make it mobile-friendly to make the Avail SDK accessible to a larger audience and onboard more users to the Avail ecosystem.
